amendment_rule: This addendum is sealed before its effective freeze instant and governs only forecasts made at or after it. It does not revise any forecast or outcome that existed when it was sealed. Any further change is another dated addendum.

cohort_2026_09_25_stands_as_published.treatment: Kept exactly as frozen and graded under the unchanged rule. NOT re-frozen, NOT backfilled: the 23 skipped pools have no 2026-09-25 forecast and never will, because a forecast made after its sealed freeze instant is not a pre-registration. That day simply contributes fewer items to the cumulative record.

title: Poolwatch v2 standing standard - addendum 1: freeze instant moves 08:30 -> 09:30 UTC (snapshot race found at the first freeze)

what_changes.completeness_gate: If Poolwatch's snapshot job is still running at the freeze instant, the freeze REFUSES and that day has no cohort (alerted). A freeze never reads a partially written snapshot day.
what_changes.forecast_object_sentence_superseded: 'Frozen once per UTC day at 08:30 UTC, after Poolwatch's 08:00 snapshot.' now reads: 'Frozen once per UTC day at 09:30 UTC, after Poolwatch's daily snapshot has COMPLETED.'
what_changes.freeze_instant: Frozen once per UTC day at 09:30 UTC (was 08:30 UTC).

what_does_not_change: Everything else in the sealed standard: fixed_rule, universe (and its sha256), models PW-B1 / PW-B1-own / PW-P1 and model_version pw-v2.0.0, widths, tiers, the outcome definition (any daily snapshot in (freeze_day, freeze_day + 14 days] outside the band; fewer than 13 snapshots = INCOMPLETE), the 28-day cumulative verdict cadence and the block bootstrap. The information a forecast uses is unchanged in kind: the same day's Poolwatch snapshot price and Market Weather candles through the last closed UTC day. The first outcome snapshot is still the NEXT day's, so a 09:30 freeze is still strictly before any outcome it is graded on.

why.effect_on_2026_09_25: The first cohort froze 18 of the 41 universe pools (base 9, arbitrum 9; 54 rows). The other 23 (eth 15, polygon_pos 5, optimism 3) were skipped with 'no usable snapshot on 2026-09-25'. The forecast_object promises every universe pool; this cohort does not deliver that.
why.finding: The standard assumed Poolwatch's 08:00 snapshot finishes before 08:30. It does not. The snapshot timer fires at 08:00 with up to 300 s random delay and commits one network at a time; on 2026-09-25 it ran 08:04:46 -> 08:42:37 UTC (base committed 08:14:46, arbitrum 08:21:25, eth 08:33:51, optimism 08:37:04, polygon_pos 08:42:36). On 2026-09-24 it ended 08:37:36. The 08:30:02 freeze therefore saw only base and arbitrum.
why.why_09_30: Latest observed snapshot completion 08:42:37 UTC; 09:30 leaves ~45 minutes of margin, and the completeness gate turns any overrun into a disclosed missing day instead of a silently partial one. The resolve (09:45 UTC) and verdict (10:05 UTC) timers still run after the freeze.
